settings.integration.label: Checks the line declares
settings.integration.why: The checks in the repository's `daoris.gates.json`, with the files its integration writes, the rules it runs and the scratch it clears. They are used only as you accept them, once for everything they serve: verifying the work that lands and integrating it. A repository's own file never grants itself.
settings.integration.accepted: Accepted. The line's checks run as you accepted them.
settings.integration.acceptedNone: Accepted: {{branch}} declares no checks, and nothing runs until some land and you accept them.
settings.integration.changed: The line's checks changed since you accepted them. Everything goes on under the ones you accepted until you accept these.
settings.integration.unaccepted: The line's checks are not accepted yet: none of them runs until you accept them.
settings.integration.unread: Where the line's checks stand could not be read here.
settings.integration.change.none: No check was added, removed or changed.
